title: Three-block cube equivalence
statement: For each natural number $d$, there is a canonical equivalence between sign vectors of length $3^{d+1}$ and triples of sign vectors, each of length $3^d$, obtained by splitting the coordinates into three consecutive blocks and arranging them as a function from a three-element set to the blocks.
